topic.title: Adversarial Robustness and Adaptive Defense Evaluation
topic.overview: Adversarial robustness concerns predictions under deliberately chosen input changes. These papers study certified noise-based defenses, robust training, feature sensitivity, minimal perturbations, and test-time protection. A central distinction is between measured resistance to a fixed attack and a guarantee that holds across the perturbations allowed by the threat model.
topic.whyItMatters: Defenses can rely on assumptions about how adversarial examples differ from clean inputs. An adaptive evaluator may exploit those assumptions, so robustness claims need both suitable attacks and clear definitions of the permitted changes.
topic.evolution: Early representatives explore adversarial feature transformations and controlled invariance. Later work develops scalable certification and explicit accuracy–robustness tradeoffs. Recent applications extend to imaging and text scoring, while analyses of CLIP defenses show why apparent test-time robustness can disappear when the attack targets the defense’s own decision rule.
openQuestions: Which certified threat models correspond to meaningful real-world perturbations?
How can evaluation detect a defense that merely changes which attacks are effective?

papers.title: Better Diffusion Models Further Improve Adversarial Training

papers.title: Certified Robust Neural Networks: Generalization and Corruption Resistance
papers.tldr: HR training uses a distributionally robust loss to combine certified corruption resistance with generalization guarantees and little additional computation.

papers.title: Detecting Adversarial Data by Probing Multiple Perturbations Using Expected Perturbation Score
papers.tldr: EPS-AD detects adversarial inputs by averaging scores across noisy perturbations and comparing the resulting statistic with natural samples.

papers.title: Do Perceptually Aligned Gradients Imply Robustness?
papers.tldr: Directly encouraging perceptually aligned gradients produces significant adversarial robustness in experiments and improves existing robust training methods.

papers.title: Eliminating Adversarial Noise via Information Discard and Robust Representation Restoration
papers.tldr: Complementary masking followed by guided representation restoration provides competitive defense against the white-box attacks evaluated in the paper.

papers.title: GAT: Guided Adversarial Training with Pareto-optimal Auxiliary Tasks
papers.tldr: GAT uses auxiliary tasks to improve adversarial robustness, with substantial reported gains when training data is limited.

papers.title: Improving Adversarial Robustness by Putting More Regularizations on Less Robust Samples
papers.tldr: Applying stronger regularization to attack-vulnerable examples improves both ordinary and adversarial accuracy in the reported experiments.

papers.title: One-vs-the-Rest Loss to Focus on Important Samples in Adversarial Training
papers.tldr: SOVR switches losses for important, small-margin examples to improve class-score separation and empirical adversarial robustness.

papers.title: Stratified Adversarial Robustness with Rejection
papers.tldr: CPR improves adversarial classification with rejection by accounting for rejection costs that decrease as perturbations grow.

papers.title: Adversarial Examples Are Not Real Features
papers.tldr: Cross-paradigm experiments suggest non-robust features behave like learning-specific shortcuts, while robust features alone may not ensure model robustness.

papers.title: Adversarial Resilience in Sequential Prediction via Abstention
papers.tldr: Allowing abstention yields stronger sequential-prediction guarantees under adversarial insertions, with distributional assumptions relaxed for specific hypothesis classes.

papers.title: Adversarial Robustness through Random Weight Sampling
papers.tldr: CTRW learns constrained random weight parameters to improve the tradeoff between ordinary accuracy and adversarial robustness.

papers.title: Adversarial Self-Training Improves Robustness and Generalization for Gradual Domain Adaptation
papers.tldr: Adversarial self-training improves robustness and clean target accuracy in gradual adaptation, with theory linking the gains to imperfect pseudo-labels.

papers.title: Balance, Imbalance, and Rebalance: Understanding Robust Overfitting from a Minimax Game Perspective
papers.tldr: ReBAT addresses robust overfitting by rebalancing the interaction between the model trainer and adversarial attacker.

papers.title: Boosting Adversarial Transferability by Achieving Flat Local Maxima
papers.tldr: Encouraging flat regions of adversarial loss improves attack transferability in experiments, with approximate gradient updates making the approach computationally practical.

papers.title: Effective Targeted Attacks for Adversarial Self-Supervised Learning
papers.tldr: Selecting similar, confusing targets for adversarial perturbations improves self-supervised robustness, especially in non-contrastive frameworks.

papers.title: Efficient Adversarial Contrastive Learning via Robustness-Aware Coreset Selection
papers.tldr: Robustness-aware subset selection speeds adversarial contrastive learning substantially while largely preserving the transferability of learned robustness.

papers.title: Eliminating Catastrophic Overfitting Via Abnormal Adversarial Examples Regularization
papers.tldr: AAER regulates abnormal adversarial examples to prevent catastrophic overfitting and improve single-step adversarial training robustness.

papers.title: Enhancing Adversarial Contrastive Learning via Adversarial Invariant Regularization
papers.tldr: Adversarial invariant regularization encourages style-independent representation distances and empirically improves downstream generalization and robustness.

papers.title: Fantastic Robustness Measures: The Secrets of Robust Generalization
papers.tldr: A large empirical study examines when margin, smoothness, and flatness measures meaningfully capture the robust generalization gap.

papers.title: Improving Adversarial Robustness via Information Bottleneck Distillation
papers.tldr: Information Bottleneck Distillation transfers robust teacher knowledge through two complementary objectives that empirically improve adversarial robustness.

papers.title: Improving Robustness with Adaptive Weight Decay
papers.tldr: Adaptive weight decay adjusts regularization at every training step and can improve adversarial robustness without extra data.

papers.title: Maximization of Average Precision for Deep Learning with Adversarial Ranking Robustness
papers.tldr: A ranking-consistency regularizer improves average precision on both clean and adversarially perturbed data in the reported experiments.

papers.title: NEO-KD: Knowledge-Distillation-Based Adversarial Training for Robust Multi-Exit Neural Networks
papers.tldr: NEO-KD uses two distillation mechanisms to improve adversarial robustness and reduce attack transfer across a network’s early exits.

papers.title: On the Adversarial Robustness of Out-of-distribution Generalization Models
papers.tldr: The paper identifies adversarial vulnerabilities in out-of-distribution generalization methods and develops two theoretically motivated algorithms that improve robustness experimentally.

papers.title: On Transfer of Adversarial Robustness from Pretraining to Downstream Tasks
papers.tldr: The robustness of pretrained representations can constrain downstream linear predictors, with theoretical bounds and practical validation.

papers.title: Perturbation Towards Easy Samples Improves Targeted Adversarial Transferability
papers.tldr: Targeting low-loss examples improves adversarial transfer, and ESMA uses this strategy with one generative model for all classes.

papers.title: Regularization properties of adversarially-trained linear regression
papers.tldr: Under specified conditions, adversarial linear regression connects to minimum-norm interpolation, ridge regression, and Lasso.

papers.title: Transferable Adversarial Robustness for Categorical Data via Universal Robust Embeddings
papers.tldr: Robust categorical embeddings transfer adversarial robustness from deep-network training to boosted trees and random forests while preserving high accuracy.

papers.title: Understanding and Improving Ensemble Adversarial Defense
papers.tldr: iGAT uses ensemble error theory to coordinate adversarial examples and address individual classifiers' weaknesses, yielding reported gains of up to 17%.

papers.title: Adversarial Robustness Limits via Scaling-Law and Human-Alignment Studies
papers.tldr: Scaling laws improve adversarial-training efficiency while predicting a robustness ceiling linked to attacks that can invalidate original image labels.

papers.title: Attack-free Evaluating and Enhancing Adversarial Robustness on Categorical Data
papers.tldr: IGSG evaluates categorical classifiers’ sensitivity and uses it to improve adversarial robustness without generating attacks.

papers.title: Be Your Own Neighborhood: Detecting Adversarial Examples by the Neighborhood Relations Built on Self-Supervised Learning
papers.tldr: BEYOND detects adversarial inputs through inconsistencies between their self-supervised representations and labels and those of their augmented neighbors.

papers.title: DataFreeShield: Defending Adversarial Attacks without Training Data
papers.tldr: DataFreeShield combines surrogate data generation with adversarial training to improve robustness without accessing real data.

papers.title: Improving Accuracy-robustness Trade-off via Pixel Reweighted Adversarial Training
papers.tldr: PART reduces adversarial perturbation budgets in less influential image regions, improving clean accuracy without reducing robustness on three evaluated datasets.

papers.title: On the Duality Between Sharpness-Aware Minimization and Adversarial Training
papers.tldr: The paper finds that SAM can improve adversarial robustness through more robust features while preserving clean accuracy in its experiments.

papers.title: OODRobustBench: a Benchmark and Large-Scale Analysis of Adversarial Robustness under Distribution Shift
papers.tldr: OODRobustBench finds substantial robustness failures under data and threat shifts, alongside a strong predictive relationship with in-distribution robustness.

papers.title: Rethinking Adversarial Robustness in the Context of the Right to be Forgotten
papers.tldr: AdvUA shows that a small fraction of malicious unlearning requests can weaken adversarial robustness and strengthen model-stealing attacks.

papers.title: Towards Efficient Training and Evaluation of Robust Models against $l_0$ Bounded Adversarial Perturbations
papers.tldr: Sparse-PGD enables efficient sparse adversarial attacks, stronger robustness evaluation, and adversarial training against limited-component perturbations.

papers.title: Two Heads are Actually Better than One: Towards Better Adversarial Robustness via Transduction and Rejection
papers.tldr: A theory-guided transductive model with rejection improves robust generalization guarantees and achieves stronger accuracy under the evaluated adversarial attacks.

papers.title: Adaptive Randomized Smoothing: Certified Adversarial Robustness for Multi-Step Defences
papers.tldr: ARS certifies adaptive, multistep defenses and improves image-classification accuracy while preserving robustness guarantees.

papers.title: Adversarially Robust Decision Transformer
papers.tldr: ARDT conditions action selection on learned worst-case returns to improve robustness against stronger adversaries.

papers.title: Adversarially Robust Multi-task Representation Learning
papers.tldr: Under shared-representation assumptions, theoretical bounds show how adversarial training across diverse tasks can improve robustness on a new task with limited data.

papers.title: Collaboration! Towards Robust Neural Methods for Routing Problems
papers.tldr: CNF collaboratively trains ensembles of neural routing models to improve attack resistance and generalization on clean and out-of-distribution instances.

papers.title: Detecting Brittle Decisions for Free: Leveraging Margin Consistency in Deep Robust Classifiers
papers.tldr: Margin consistency identifies when a classifier’s logit margin can efficiently flag decisions vulnerable to adversarial perturbations.

papers.title: Efficient Adversarial Training in LLMs with Continuous Attacks
papers.tldr: Training against efficient continuous embedding attacks improves resistance to tested discrete language-model attacks while maintaining utility.

papers.title: Exploring Adversarial Robustness of Deep State Space Models
papers.tldr: Adaptive Scaling helps state space models benefit from adversarial training while avoiding the robust overfitting observed with attention.

papers.title: Faster Repeated Evasion Attacks in Tree Ensembles
papers.tldr: The method speeds repeated attacks on tree ensembles by identifying and reusing a small set of commonly perturbed features.

papers.title: GREAT Score: Global Robustness Evaluation of Adversarial Perturbation using Generative Models
papers.tldr: GREAT Score estimates average certified robustness over a generative model's distribution without running adversarial attacks.

papers.title: Improving Adversarial Robust Fairness via Anti-Bias Soft Label Distillation
papers.tldr: Class-specific distillation temperatures improve the reported balance of adversarial robustness across easy and hard classes.

papers.title: Learning Bregman Divergences with Application to Robustness
papers.tldr: Learned Bregman divergences provide image similarity measures that support adversarial training with improved robustness to common corruptions.

papers.title: MALT Powers Up Adversarial Attacks
papers.tldr: MALT uses local approximate linearity to select attack targets, surpassing AutoAttack’s coverage with a reported five-times-faster strategy.

papers.title: On the Scalability of Certified Adversarial Robustness with Generated Data
papers.tldr: Diffusion-generated training data improves deterministic certified robustness, with scaling behavior that differs from empirical adversarial training.

papers.title: RAMP: Boosting Adversarial Robustness Against Multiple $l_p$ Perturbations for Universal Robustness
papers.tldr: RAMP combines logit pairing and gradient projection to improve robustness across multiple perturbation norms while moderating accuracy tradeoffs.

papers.title: Rapid Plug-in Defenders
papers.tldr: CeTaD rapidly adapts a pretrained Transformer defender by tuning normalization parameters while leaving the deployed target model unchanged.

papers.title: Self-Supervised Adversarial Training via Diverse Augmented Queries and Self-Supervised Double Perturbation
papers.tldr: DAQ-SDP improves label-free adversarial training through diverse augmented queries and a self-supervised double-perturbation scheme.

papers.title: SuperDeepFool: a new fast and accurate minimal adversarial attack
papers.tldr: SuperDeepFool generalizes DeepFool to find small ℓ2 adversarial perturbations more effectively and efficiently, supporting robustness evaluation and adversarial training.

papers.title: Training for Stable Explanation for Free
papers.tldr: R2ET uses an efficient training regularizer and a top-feature stability metric to improve explanation robustness, supported by theory and experiments.

papers.title: Transferability Bound Theory: Exploring Relationship between Adversarial Transferability and Flatness
papers.tldr: A transferability bound shows that greater flatness alone does not guarantee stronger cross-model attacks and motivates the TPA attack.

papers.title: Transferable Adversarial Attacks on SAM and Its Downstream Models
papers.tldr: UMI-GRAT improves attacks transferred from public SAM to downstream models without access to their tasks or datasets.

papers.title: Understanding and Improving Adversarial Collaborative Filtering for Robust Recommendation
papers.tldr: PamaCF personalizes adversarial perturbation magnitudes using user embedding scales, improving recommendation performance and resistance to poisoning attacks.

papers.title: Wide Two-Layer Networks can Learn from Adversarial Perturbations
papers.tldr: For wide two-layer networks, the paper proves that adversarial perturbations contain sufficient class information to explain successful learning from mislabeled adversarial examples.

papers.title: Adapting to Evolving Adversaries with Regularized Continual Robust Training
papers.tldr: Regularizing attack-induced changes in model output scores helps models adapt to new adversaries while retaining robustness against earlier attacks.

papers.title: Adversarial Cooperative Rationalization: The Risk of Spurious Correlations in Even Clean Datasets
papers.tldr: Cooperative rationale extraction can create misleading correlations even in clean data, and the paper develops an attack-informed method to counter them.

papers.title: Adversarial Robustness in Two-Stage Learning-to-Defer: Algorithms and Guarantees
papers.tldr: SARD strengthens two-stage delegation against adversarial misrouting, with consistent surrogate losses and improved empirical robustness.

papers.title: Adversarial Robustness via Deformable Convolution with Stochasticity
papers.tldr: Stochastic deformable convolution introduces randomness into network structure and uses a theoretical accuracy analysis to improve adversarial defense training.

papers.title: AutoAdvExBench: Benchmarking Autonomous Exploitation of Adversarial Example Defenses
papers.tldr: AutoAdvExBench finds that success against exercise-style adversarial defenses does not reliably reflect success against real-world defenses.

papers.title: Boosting Adversarial Robustness with CLAT: Criticality Leveraged Adversarial Training
papers.tldr: CLAT dynamically fine-tunes robustness-critical layers to reduce adversarial overfitting and improve clean accuracy and adversarial robustness.

papers.title: Enhancing Adversarial Robustness with Conformal Prediction: A Framework for Guaranteed Model Reliability
papers.tldr: OPSA attacks conformal prediction efficiency by increasing uncertainty, while OPSA-AT uses that attack to improve empirical adversarial robustness.

papers.title: Flexible, Efficient, and Stable Adversarial Attacks on Machine Unlearning
papers.tldr: DDPA uses geometric approximations to make adversarial machine-unlearning requests more flexible, efficient, and stable.

papers.title: Identifying and Understanding Cross-Class Features in Adversarial Training
papers.tldr: The study links strong adversarial robustness to shared cross-class features and robust overfitting to increasing reliance on class-specific features.

papers.title: Improving Zero-Shot Adversarial Robustness in Vision-Language Models by Closed-form Alignment of Adversarial Path Simplices
papers.tldr: A closed-form alignment formulation uses regions along adversarial trajectories to improve zero-shot vision-language robustness without costly explicit simplex sampling.

papers.title: Not All Wrong is Bad: Using Adversarial Examples for Unlearning
papers.tldr: AMUN uses nearby adversarial examples to reduce confidence on forgotten samples while preserving test accuracy, with strong reported membership-inference results.

papers.title: On the Adversarial Robustness of Multi-Kernel Clustering
papers.tldr: AdvMKC uses reinforcement learning and an approximate clusterer to evaluate multi-kernel clustering vulnerabilities through efficient black-box attacks.

papers.title: On the Alignment between Fairness and Accuracy: from the Perspective of Adversarial Robustness
papers.tldr: The paper connects adversarial attacks on fairness and accuracy and develops joint training that improves robustness to both.

papers.title: One Stone, Two Birds: Enhancing Adversarial Defense Through the Lens of Distributional Discrepancy
papers.tldr: DAD uses one optimized distributional discrepancy measure to guide denoising and detect adversarial inputs, improving both clean and robust accuracy in experiments.

papers.title: Optimizing Robustness and Accuracy in Mixture of Experts: A Dual-Model Approach
papers.tldr: Targeted expert robustification and a jointly trained dual-model mixture provide control over the accuracy–robustness trade-off.

papers.title: ROME is Forged in Adversity: Robust Distilled Datasets via Information Bottleneck
papers.tldr: ROME combines accuracy preservation with feature-distribution alignment to improve adversarial robustness of models trained on distilled datasets.

papers.title: Scaling Trends in Language Model Robustness
papers.tldr: Robustness scaling depends on attack and defense resources, with larger models improving adversarial-training sample efficiency but not compute efficiency.

papers.title: Self-Consuming Generative Models with Adversarially Curated Data
papers.tldr: The paper analyzes stability under noisy synthetic-data curation and develops budget-limited attacks that steer rivals away from user preferences.

papers.title: Towards LLM Unlearning Resilient to Relearning Attacks: A Sharpness-Aware Minimization Perspective and Beyond
papers.tldr: Smoothness-based optimization makes language-model unlearning more resistant to relearning attacks and also helps against evaluated jailbreaks.

papers.title: Understanding Model Ensemble in Transferable Adversarial Attack
papers.tldr: A theoretical analysis connects ensemble attack transferability to vulnerability, diversity, and complexity, with support from experiments involving 54 models.

papers.title: Accelerated Vertical Federated Adversarial Learning through Decoupling Layer-Wise Dependencies
papers.tldr: DecVFAL reduces communication and waiting during federated adversarial training, reporting roughly 3–10× speedups with competitive robustness.

papers.title: Boosting Adversarial Transferability with Spatial Adversarial Alignment
papers.tldr: Aligning a surrogate model’s spatial and adversarial features with a witness model improves attack transferability, especially across architectures.

papers.title: Consensus-Robust Transfer Attacks via Parameter and Representation Perturbations
papers.tldr: CORTA models uncertainty in both weights and internal representations to improve the transferability of untargeted adversarial attacks.

papers.title: Distributional Adversarial Attacks and Training in Deep Hedging
papers.tldr: Training deep hedging strategies against adversarial distribution shifts improves their robustness and out-of-sample performance in the reported experiments.

papers.title: Exploring Semantic-constrained Adversarial Example with Instruction Uncertainty Reduction
papers.tldr: InSUR improves language-guided adversarial generation by reducing uncertainty in sampling, scenario constraints, and semantic evaluation.

papers.title: MixAT: Combining Continuous and Discrete Adversarial Training for LLMs
papers.tldr: MIXAT combines discrete and continuous adversarial training to reduce measured attack success while retaining runtime comparable to continuous-only approaches.

papers.title: OSTAR: Optimized Statistical Text-classifier with Adversarial Resistance
papers.tldr: OSTAR combines statistical text features with contrastive learning on attacked text to improve machine-generated-text detection under adversarial conditions.

papers.title: RUAGO: Effective and Practical Retain-Free Unlearning via Adversarial Attack and OOD Generator
papers.tldr: RUAGO combines controlled forgetting with aligned synthetic data to preserve model utility during unlearning without retained training examples.

papers.title: Understanding and Improving Adversarial Robustness of Neural Probabilistic Circuits
papers.tldr: RNPC changes how attribute recognition and probabilistic reasoning are combined to provably improve robustness against attacks on recognized attributes.

papers.title: Understanding and Improving Fast Adversarial Training against $l_0$ Bounded Perturbations
papers.tldr: Smoothing the loss landscape improves one-step adversarial training against sparse attacks and reduces catastrophic overfitting in the reported experiments.

papers.title: Versatile Transferable Unlearnable Example Generator
papers.tldr: VTG generates protective data perturbations designed to remain effective across changes in style, classes, resolution, and learning architecture.

papers.title: Vulnerable Data-Aware Adversarial Training
papers.tldr: VDAT filters training examples using margin-based vulnerability estimates to improve adversarial-training efficiency and accuracy.

papers.title: Adversarial Attacks and Robust Training for Hypergraph Neural Networks
papers.tldr: MeLA attacks hypergraph neural networks under partial model access, while a companion adversarial-training method improves their defenses.

papers.title: Adversarial Robustness of Implicit Neural Representation-Based Classifiers
papers.tldr: Surrogate attacks reveal severe adversarial vulnerabilities in classifiers that encode inputs as implicit neural representations.

papers.title: Benign Overfitting in Adversarial Training for Vision Transformers
papers.tldr: Under specified signal, perturbation, and model conditions, adversarially trained Vision Transformers can overfit while still generalizing robustly.

papers.title: Calibrating Uncertainty for Zero-Shot Adversarial CLIP
papers.tldr: A distribution-based fine-tuning objective improves CLIP’s uncertainty calibration under adversarial perturbations while preserving clean accuracy.

papers.title: Does a Hybrid Space-Aware Randomized Defense Improve Empirical and Certified Adversarial Robustness?
papers.tldr: HySCAN combines parameter and feature randomness to improve certified and empirical adversarial robustness without reducing clean accuracy in reported experiments.

papers.title: Harnessing Non-Adversarial Robustness in Large Language Models
papers.tldr: Targeted debiasing can improve robustness to meaning-preserving prompt changes under identified conditions, with certification against random perturbations.

papers.title: Mind Your Margin and Boundary: Are Your Distilled Datasets Truly Robust?
papers.tldr: C²R improves robust dataset distillation by prioritizing vulnerable adversarial examples and increasing separation between classes.

papers.title: On the Existence of Consistent Adversarial Attacks in High-Dimensional Linear Classification
papers.tldr: A metric for label-preserving attacks reveals increasing adversarial vulnerability with overparameterization in the paper’s high-dimensional classification settings.

papers.title: Position: Adversarial ML for LLMs Is Not Making Any Progress
papers.tldr: The authors warn that poorly defined problems and weak evaluations may prevent LLM adversarial research from delivering meaningful security progress.

papers.title: Posterior Mismatch Matters: Adversarial Training for Long-Tailed Robustness
papers.tldr: PAT combines learned class-probability supervision with weight perturbations to improve adversarial robustness on imbalanced datasets.

papers.title: Robust In-Context Reinforcement Learning Under Reward Poisoning Attacks
papers.tldr: Training a decision transformer against learned reward-poisoning attackers improves its reported robustness in bandits and more complex environments.

papers.title: SORA: Free Second-Order Attacks in Fast Adversarial Training
papers.tldr: SORA adapts adversarial perturbations to loss geometry, preventing catastrophic overfitting across the reported fast-training experiments.

papers.title: Towards Understanding Generalization of Federated Adversarial Learning: Perspective of Algorithmic Stability
papers.tldr: Stability analysis explains perturbation-dependent generalization in federated adversarial learning and motivates smoother, black-box-compatible alternatives.

papers.title: Training-Free Adversarial Robustness in Computational MRI
papers.tldr: A cyclic measurement-consistency objective mitigates adversarial MRI reconstruction distortions without retraining, including in evaluated blind and adaptive attack settings.

papers.title: Unifying Adversarial Robustness and Training Across Text Scoring Models
papers.tldr: A unified text-scoring perspective enables complementary adversarial training methods that improve robustness, task effectiveness, and resistance to reward hacking.

papers.title: You Don’t Protect if You Don’t Expect: Breaking the Key Assumption behind CLIP’s Test-Time Defenses
papers.tldr: CLIP-MAD undermines test-time defenses by attacking the assumed distinction used to decide whether an input needs protection.
